summary: Conditional slot-resource release. Reads the dword at offset 0x5C of this; when it is not -1, passes it to sub_58C331 for release and resets offset 0x5C to -1. Returns the slot value read (or the release function's result). No-op when the slot is already -1.

local_names.this: object owning the slot-resource handle at offset 0x5C
local_names.result: dword read from offset 0x5C; later the release function's return value

operations.description: Reads the slot-resource handle from offset 0x5C of this into result
Proceeds only when the handle at offset 0x5C is not -1; otherwise skips release
Releases the resource handle by calling sub_58C331 with the value at offset 0x5C
Resets offset 0x5C of this to -1 (inactive) after the release
Returns the release function's result, or the previously read slot value when already inactive
Invoked as a cleanup path by AudioStreamCloseAndCleanup, sub_4069F0 and LinkedListTraversalByID

unresolved: sub_58C331's exact release semantics and whether its return value is meaningful to callers are defined outside this packet
The -1 sentinel at offset 0x5C marks an inactive slot; the slot index this handle refers to is not recoverable from this packet
